Class XmlTierData

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlTierData
public class XmlTierData extends Object
User tier data

Java class for tierData complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="tierData">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <choice maxOccurs="unbounded">
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tw"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tc"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}internal-media"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ta"/>
       </choice>
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

  • Method Details

    • getTwOrTcOrInternalMedia

      public List<Object> getTwOrTcOrInternalMedia()
      Gets the value of the twOrTcOrInternalMedia property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the twOrTcOrInternalMedia property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getTwOrTcOrInternalMedia().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlTierWordType XmlTierCommentType XmlMediaType XmlTierLinkType
